answer: Bind each account to one walnut shell kept as a relic: its grain is unique, photographed once, and hashed into the account. Each epoch a random audit asks the holder to sign a fresh phrase with a quill and place the shell beside the note in one photo, so handwriting, ink strokes, and shell grain must all match the same person. A Sybil farm would need a distinct shell, hand, and writing session per fake identity, and shells cannot be copied or rented at scale without identical grains betraying the fraud, while any account whose relic never appears in an audit quietly loses its seat.
